column7: I consider my neighborhood somewhat safe. From a financial perspective, I am paying more in rent than I ideally should, but I made this choice because I felt unsafe while touring apartments closer to the medical campus and hospital. As a woman who sometimes heads to the lab late in the evening, I needed a place where I could come and go without major concerns. While I still would not feel entirely comfortable running outside from my apartment as I would like to, it is much better than other options within a budget that aligns more closely with my stipend. One of my classmates and friends lives with three other people in a basement apartment and pays half of what I pay in rent. However, she regularly hears gunshots at night and was recently kept awake all night after being woken by people yelling “on your knees!” along with loud commotion outside. I am making other daily sacrifices to accommodate safe living within the limits of my stipend.
